basic_details.short_information: The Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN), Thiruvarur, is hiring 2 Counsellors (one male and one female) on a temporary contract for its student and university counselling services. Applications go by email to [email protected]. The closing date for applications is 5 November 2026. The pay is Rs. 50,000 per month (consolidated), and selection is by interview only.

content_sections.heading: About CUTN
content_sections.text: The Central University of Tamil Nadu is a central university set up by an Act of Parliament in 2009. It is located at Neelakudi, Thiruvarur – 610 005. The Counsellor posts are for the university's student and university Counselling Services.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice calls this an offline process. Applications must be sent by email to [email protected] between 21 October 2026 and 5 November 2026. The notice does not give a time for the closing date. It does not say whether the date is for receipt or for sending. Get the application form from the university website, www.cutn.ac.in. The notice says the form "will be updated" on that website. Fill in the application. Attach duly signed scanned copies of your educational certificates, your RCI/NCAHP Registration Certificate and your experience certificates. Email the application and the scanned certificates to [email protected] by 5 November 2026. Send any questions about the recruitment to [email protected] . content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are 2 Counsellor posts (02 Nos.): one for a male candidate and one for a female candidate. The work is at Central University of Tamil Nadu, Thiruvarur. You need one of the qualifications (a) to (d). Candidates with (b), (c) or (d) also need the experience in (e). Everyone needs the registration in (f). (a) Two-year M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology / Psy.D. in Clinical Psychology from a University/Institution recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR (b) Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology from a University/Institution recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR (c) Ph.D. in Counselling Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Psychology / Applied Psychology with a Regular Postgraduate degree in Psychology / Counselling Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology from a recognised university. OR (d) Regular Postgraduate qualification in Psychology / Counselling Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology from a recognised university, with a regular Postgraduate Diploma in Counselling Psychology / Guidance and Counselling. AND (e) For qualifications (b) to (d): at least one year of relevant experience in counselling after completing the qualifying degree, preferably in a Higher Educational Institution. AND (f) Valid registration with RCI (Rehabilitation Council of India) or NCAHP (National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions) is mandatory. Proficiency in conducting both individual and group counselling sessions using evidence-based therapeutic approaches. Capability to manage psychiatric emergencies and provide effective crisis intervention. Competence in developing psycho-educational content aimed at promoting student mental health and well-being. Working knowledge of computers, including MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel). Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Tamil, with effective interpersonal abilities. Prior clinical or counselling experience in a university/college or higher educational setting will be considered an added advantage. Insight into the unique psychological challenges faced by students in competitive academic environments. Demonstrated empathy, sensitivity to diversity, and a non-judgmental counselling approach. Familiarity with a range of counselling techniques, therapeutic modalities and psychological assessment tools. The upper age limit is 40 years (preferably). The notice does not give an "as on" date for age. Remuneration: Rs. 50,000/- per month (Consolidated). Nature of the post: On-Contract (Temporary). The position is purely temporary. Duration: initially ONE (01) year. It can be extended based on performance and university requirements. Working hours: 5 working days per week, in rotational shifts. Saturdays, Sundays and holidays may be working days as per university requirements. Shifts are assigned based on university requirements. content_sections.heading: CUTN Counsellor Job Description
content_sections.text: The Counsellor will work closely with students, faculty members and staff. The role covers counselling services, workshops and campus-wide mental health and well-being initiatives. The listed responsibilities are: Provide individualized one-on-one counselling sessions to students. Facilitate group counselling sessions addressing common student mental health concerns. Organize and deliver workshops, seminars and webinars on mental health and psychological well-being. Conduct psychometric assessments and prepare clinical case reports as required. Maintain strict confidentiality and manage sensitive student information with discretion and professionalism. Conduct regular courses and interactive sessions for Psychology students. Conduct training programs for student peer mentors and support volunteers. Prepare and submit monthly analytical reports for performance review and program evaluation. Provide crisis intervention and manage psychiatric emergencies effectively. Collaborate with faculty, hostel wardens and administrative staff to support student well-being initiatives.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly signed scanned copies of educational certificates RCI/NCAHP Registration Certificate Experience certificates (wherever applicable) An application will be summarily rejected if the educational qualification certificates, the RCI/NCAHP registration certificate or the experience certificates (wherever applicable) are missing.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the CUTN Counsellor posts is on an interview basis only, and the interview is held online. The date of the online interview will be notified separately. Selected applicants will be informed, and the interview link will be shared with them by email.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates who meet the eligibility criteria may apply. The engagement is purely temporary and gives no right to a permanent appointment or absorption in the university.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CUTN Counsellor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Counsellor posts: one for a male candidate and one for a female candidate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CUTN Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The closing date for applications is 5 November 2026. The application window opened on 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CUTN Counsellor post?
faq.answer: You need a two-year M.Phil./Psy.D. in Clinical Psychology from an RCI-recognised institution, or one of the other qualifications in the notice. Those other qualifications also need one year of counselling experience. Valid RCI or NCAHP registration is mandatory for everyone.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CUTN Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years (preferably).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a CUTN Counsellor?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 50,000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CUTN Counsellor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your application to [email protected] with duly signed scanned copies of your educational certificates, RCI/NCAHP Registration Certificate and experience certificates. The application form will be posted on www.cutn.ac.in.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the CUTN Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Selection is on an interview basis only, and the interview is held online. Its date will be notified separately, and the link will be sent by email to the selected applicants.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CUTN Counsellor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The job is on a temporary contract, initially for one year, and it can be extended based on performance and university requirements. It gives no right to a permanent appointment or absorption in the university.

faq.question: Q9. Is experience required for the CUTN Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying with qualification (b), (c) or (d) need at least one year of relevant counselling experience after the qualifying degree, preferably in a Higher Educational Institution.

faq.question: Q10. What are the working hours of a CUTN Counsellor?
faq.answer: The Counsellor works 5 days a week in rotational shifts. Saturdays, Sundays and holidays may be working days as per university requirements, and the Counsellor must be available on phone after duty hours for emergencies.
